clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Deathguard Bartholomew keeps watch over the town and helps travelers find their way. He helps keep order among the Forsaken defenders of Tirisfal Glades.

Deathguard Bartholomew keeps watch in Brill, part of the Forsaken guard defending Tirisfal Glades. Like other Deathguards, he protects reclaimed land from the lingering Scourge, fanatical Scarlet Crusaders, and other threats to Lady Sylvanas's domain. He also guides travelers around the town and helps keep order among the newly risen.
